title: Structures of NF-kappaB p52 homodimer-DNA complexes rationalize binding mechanisms and transcription activation.
authors: Pan, Wenfei; Meshcheryakov, Vladimir A; Li, Tianjie; Wang, Yi; Ghosh, Gourisankar; Wang, Vivien Ya-Fan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过晶体结构和微秒级分子动力学模拟，解析NF-kappaB p52同源二聚体与不同kappaB DNA序列的复合物构象，揭示DNA动态构象与结合动力学如何决定转录激活，是典型的TF-DNA互作机制与物理模拟结合的高匹配文献。
abstract: The mammalian NF-kappaB p52:p52 homodimer together with its cofactor Bcl3 activates transcription of kappaB sites with a central G/C base pair (bp), while it is inactive toward kappaB sites with a central A/T bp. To understand the molecular basis for this unique property of p52, we have determined the crystal structures of recombinant human p52 protein in complex with a P-selectin(PSel)-kappaB DNA (5'-GGGGTGACCCC-3') (central bp is underlined) and variants changing the central bp to A/T or swapping the flanking bp. The structures reveal a nearly two-fold widened minor groove in the central region of the DNA as compared to all other currently available NF-kappaB-DNA complex structures, which have a central A/T bp. Microsecond molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of free DNAs and p52 bound complexes reveal that free DNAs exhibit distinct preferred conformations, and p52:p52 homodimer induces the least amount of DNA conformational changes when bound to the more transcriptionally active natural G/C-centric PSel-kappaB, but adopts closed conformation when bound to the mutant A/T and swap DNAs due to their narrowed minor grooves. Our binding assays further demonstrate that the fast kinetics favored by entropy is correlated with higher transcriptional activity. Overall, our studies have revealed a novel conformation for kappaB DNA in complex with NF-kappaB and pinpoint the importance of binding kinetics, dictated by DNA conformational and dynamic states, in controlling transcriptional activation for NF-kappaB.
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物NF-kappaB p52:p52同源二聚体与其辅因子Bcl3共同激活具有中心G/C碱基对（bp）的kappaB位点的转录，而对中心A/T碱基对的kappaB位点则无活性。为理解p52这一独特性质的分子基础，我们解析了重组人p52蛋白与P-选择素(PSel)-kappaB DNA（5'-GGGGTGACCCC-3'）（中心碱基对以下划线标示）及其中心碱基对改为A/T或侧翼碱基对互换的变体的晶体结构。结构揭示，与所有其他现有NF-kappaB-DNA复合物结构（其中心为A/T碱基对）相比，该DNA中心区域的次要沟槽几乎加宽了两倍。对游离DNA和p52结合复合物的微秒级分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟显示，游离DNA表现出不同的优选构象，且p52:p52同源二聚体在结合转录活性更高的天然G/C中心PSel-kappaB时诱导的DNA构象变化最小，但在结合突变型A/T和互换DNA时，由于其次要沟槽变窄，则采用闭合构象。我们的结合实验进一步证明，由熵驱动的快速动力学与更高的转录活性相关。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了kappaB DNA与NF-kappaB复合物的一种新构象，并指出了由DNA构象和动态状态决定的结合动力学在控制NF-kappaB转录激活中的重要性。
